immutable_evidence_groups: P5-05 final baseline, evidence map, and checksum inventory
permitted_post_freeze_changes: paper and presentation development that references the frozen baseline
prohibited_post_freeze_changes: editing frozen cases or expected outcomes
editing P5-01 or P5-04 raw results
changing model or evidence thresholds without a new evaluation version
replacing failed or partial historical evidence
claiming production readiness or autonomous final authority

hosted_ci_acceptance.final_confirmation_method: GitHub Actions run and retained workflow artifact

production_boundary: Controlled capstone prototype; nonbinding recommendations only; no autonomous external action; final human authority required.
